L0: # Retrieve a price
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.

L9: 
L10: Retrieves the price with the given ID.
L11: ## Prerequisites
L12: 
L13: Before you can run the following code snippet, you need to call these APIs with the provided parameters to set up the prerequisite API object(s).
L14: 
L15: 1. createPrice
L16: POST /v1/prices {"currency":"usd","unit_amount":1000,"recurring":{"interval":"month"},"product_data":{"name":"Gold Plan"}}
L17: 
L18: ## Request
L19: 
L20: ```curl
L21: curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/prices/{{PRICE_ID}} \
L22:   -u "<<YOUR_SECRET_KEY>>"
L23: ```

L55: Returns a price if a valid price or plan ID was provided. Raises [an error](https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors.md) otherwise.
